name: open-music-performance
description: Free, open-source, self-hostable live-music platform. Planning and schema stage.

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run schema:check && npm run test -w @omp/tickets && npm run test -w @omp/scanner && npm run test -w @omp/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @omp/tickets && npm run typecheck -w @omp/scanner && npm run typecheck -w @omp/server
scripts.build: npm run build -w @omp/tickets && npm run build -w @omp/scanner
